item.title: La Pige – Diego A. Pinto De Queiros : Une moustache pour parler de deux cancers masculins
item.dc:creator: Diego A. Pinto De Queiros
item.description: Ces deux cancers touchent la zone du bassin, mais ils ne frappent pas au même âge. Au Québec, 18 hommes reçoivent chaque jour un diagnostic de cancer de la prostate, selon l’organisme PROCURE, soit environ 6 600 par année. Au Saguenay, on en compte 276 par année et, selon le directeur général de Cancer Saguenay, Dany Brisson, le nombre de cas augmente avec le vieillissement de la population.

item.title: The Plant – Frances Juntilla: Creative Writing October 2026
item.dc:creator: Frances Juntilla
item.description: With the start of the next semester, our very fitting theme for the submissions this issue was renewal. I feel like renewal has a very binary connotation: transitioning from a flawed past to an improved present. However, I feel that it’s much more nuanced than that. Our lives are not memoir, we don’t have one defining incident that separates our life into a distinct before and after.

item.title: The Plant: The Existential Horror of AI
item.dc:creator: The Plant
item.description: October— while being a time of laughter, candy and silly costumes— can also be a time that makes us reflect on our fears. A fear is never just a fear, it’s always rooted in something deeper. The older I grow, the less afraid I am of the things that go bump in the night. The supernatural creatures of the world don’t keep me up anymore, the world we live in does.
